project.name: catalyst-interceptor (aggregator)
project.description:
Aggregator for the Scala side of the engine. Four layers, strictly ordered:
interceptor-api - Spark-agnostic SPI. No concrete Catalyst types. interceptor-dispatch - ServiceLoader-based runtime shim selection. interceptor-runtime - SparkSessionExtensions + Rule[LogicalPlan]. interceptor-spark-* - One implementation per Spark/Scala binary cell. interceptor-bundle-* - Shaded fat jar consumed by the Python wheel.
Module order below is the dependency order and Maven honours it. interceptor-bundle-* is listed LAST because it packages every other module, so it must build after all of them.
Note that interceptor-spark-3.5_2.13 builds BEFORE interceptor-runtime is tested: runtime test-depends on the shim to exercise ServiceLoader resolution end to end. Maven resolves this ordering automatically from the declared dependencies; the listing order here is documentation.
